Page 1 – Before You Begin
A Professional Guide for Your New Career in Germany
Welcome!
Congratulations on taking the next step in your professional career.
Moving to another country is an important decision. It is natural to have many questions
before travelling to Germany.
This handbook has been prepared to provide you with clear, honest and transparent
information about every important step of your journey.
Our goal is simple:
✔ To protect you against fraud.
✔ To explain the complete recruitment and visa process.
✔ To help you understand your rights and responsibilities.
✔ To prepare you for your ﬁrst job in Germany.
✔ To answer the most common questions before your arrival.
✔ To help you start your new career with conﬁdence.

OUR PROMISE
EuroJobsCenter believes that every international professional driver deserves complete
transparency before travelling to Germany.
For this reason, we explain not only the opportunities, but also the responsibilities of
living and working in Germany.
We do not make unrealistic promises.
We provide honest information so that every driver can make an informed decision and
begin a successful long-term career in Germany.
"Trust. Transparency. Professionalism. "
